Response: "Talk of gods makes my scales itch. If the Living Gods really cared, they wouldn't make me suffer. Now take your religious foolishness and peddle it someplace else."
"That's something to do with the Tribunal, isn't it? I'm sorry, but I really try not to pay too much attention to the Dark Elves and their strange religion."
"Oh, that's from the Dark Elf scriptures, isn't it? Enigmatic and beautiful. I've been trying to catch up on my reading, but I've been so busy, busy, busy."
"What? What did you say? I suggest you leave now, before I set the guards upon you."
"Don't you have better things to do than quote my religion at me?"
"Word of advice. Don't mention anything related to the Tribunal to the governor. He's not happy with some recent rules and regulations that have come down from on high."

"Ha! That's a good one! That Tribunal nonsense is almost as funny as some of the things I heard in Wrothgar. Say, if you want to get together later, I know a couple of bawdy stories that I'd love to share."

"Really, outlander, it's commendable that you're trying to learn our ways, but the words of the Tribunal just sound silly when you say them like that. I suggest you stick to sight-seeing and leave the religion to us."
